title: Quarantine legacy native-profile address fixtures
description: Discovered from project-LICHEN-worker6-1k3i: test/vectors/yggdrasil-derivation.json, the lichen_native_sha512 vectors in test/vectors/yggdrasil_address.json, and test/vectors/yggdrasil.json encode the rejected SHA-512 native address profile and are still cross-referenced as conformance oracles by spec prose (03-addressing.md, 04-network.md) and code tests (rust/lichen-core/tests/yggdrasil_addr_vectors.rs, python/tests/crypto/test_yggdrasil_address_vectors.py). Per AGENTS.md these are conflicting legacy fixtures to be reported, not conformance oracles. Decide and execute: delete, move to a clearly-labeled legacy/quarantine file, or regenerate against upstream AddrForKey; update all referencing tests and prose. Do not weaken the pinned upstream_addr_for_key byte-equality vector.
close_reason: Parent closes with all 6 children. Verified each deliverable content on the landing branches (swarm convention: branch commits = done; merges to main are sync-process mechanical): .1 legacy/ dir + README with yggdrasil.json, yggdrasil-derivation.json, yggdrasil_address_native_sha512.json, ipv6_addresses_native_sha512.json (beads-worker-2). .2 live yggdrasil_address.json stripped — the only remaining native reference is a rejected_profile_note pointing at the quarantine file; Rust yggdrasil_addr_vectors.rs + Python test_yggdrasil_address_vectors.py rewritten (beads-worker-2). .3 ipv6-addresses.json native fields quarantined; test_addr.py + ipv6_address_vectors.rs + generator updated (beads-worker-2). .4 C-side hardcoded native vectors quarantine-labeled in ipv6_addr.h/identity_addr.c/link_ctx.h + tests (beads-worker-3, 4e7fe193e0). .5 spec prose repointed — main's 04-network.md:75 and 06-security.md:105/115/139 already name the pinned upstream_addr_for_key vector the sole conformance oracle and reject the SHA-512 native profile; cd7ade8864 extends this. .6 x25519.json + gcp3_trust_models.json carry explicit QUARANTINE NOTEs marking native fields internal-consistency pins, never oracles (beads-worker-6). No stale live-path references: remaining consumers (test_vectors.py:2398, ipv6_address_vectors.rs:5-6) load legacy/ paths with non-oracle labels. The pinned upstream_addr_for_key byte-equality vector is untouched throughout. Verification-only closure; no files changed, no review passes applicable.
